1.explanation:
• audits/redirects-test.js defines the “Avoid multiple page redirects” audit and its savings calculation.  
• performance-category-renderer-test.js drives rendering of the Opportunities table in the Performance section.  
• details-renderer-test.js contains the template and layout logic for individual opportunity rows, including the bar chart cell.  
• util-test.js covers helper functions used to format savings values and bar widths.  
• dom-test.js verifies the DOM structure (table, rows, cells, chart wrappers) used in the report.  
• category-renderer-test.js ensures the Performance category container (including its header and grouping of opportunities) is generated correctly.  

Together, these documents provide the audit data, rendering templates, styling hooks, and DOM structure needed to reproduce the squished layout and adjust row sizing or CSS to fix the issue.
1.bug_scenario: In the Lighthouse HTML report’s “Opportunities” section (Performance category), the final row — “Avoid multiple page redirects” — is rendered with its savings bar and label cramped under the table header and misaligned. The horizontal bar chart overlaps the header border, the “Potential savings of 1,550 ms” text is pushed down and indented, and the row height is too small, causing the entire opportunity entry to appear visually squished.
